open_points.subject: _build_imported_plans
open_points.text: _build_imported_plans: [PROVENANCE] MUST pair each snapshot section with its linked = models.PortalSection and build one = models.SectionPlan per pair with the imported build_imported_section_plan, passing the version, that section, that snapshot section and created_at; it MUST NOT derive values from expenses. An imported plan names no editor (M23 gives updated_by to manual plans only), and its author stays on the created_by_id of the BudgetVersion.
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The note must state the behavioral and provenance result without describing the builder call or its argument passing.

open_points.subject: _link_snapshot_sections
open_points.text: _link_snapshot_sections: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST return exactly one PortalSection per snapshot section in input order, reuse the exact existing object whose source_key matches source_section_id, and build the sections of the unmatched snapshot sections with the imported build_snapshot_sections, passing actor_id, created_at, the project_id of the existing sections and those unmatched snapshot sections; with no existing section it MUST raise BudgetValidationError; it MUST NOT omit already linked sections.

микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The note must describe the required returned sections and provenance without spelling out a builder invocation and argument list.

open_points.subject: activate_budget_version
open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST replace both versions with the imported revise_budget_version at the single utc_now instant of the operation: for the prior different active version it passes the INACTIVE member of = models.BudgetVersionStatus as status, that instant as deactivated_at and its own activated_at and activated_by unchanged; for the requested version its ACTIVE member as status, that instant as activated_at, the actor_id of the context as activated_by and None as deactivated_at; it MUST then pass non-active updates before the active update.
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The note must specify the resulting version fields and ordering without expressing a revise_budget_version call or its keyword arguments.

open_points.subject: activate_budget_version
open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST append exactly one audit whose intent the imported build_project_audit_intent builds from the context, the snapshot.activate member of = models.AuditAction, the BUDGET_VERSION member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the requested version_id as entity_id, commit the version changes and audit atomically, and return the result the imported build_budget_activation_result builds from the activated BudgetVersion object, its ordered plans and the pre-update unresolved allocation count.

open_points.question: The note must state the audit and return requirements without encoding builder calls and their argument lists.

open_points.subject: ensure_manual_budget
open_points.text: ensure_manual_budget: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] When no manual version exists, MUST build the new = models.BudgetVersion with the imported build_manual_budget_version, passing the context and the single utc_now instant as now, insert that exact object, build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the budget.manual_version_create member of = models.AuditAction, the BUDGET_VERSION member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the new version_id as entity_id and append it via the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, commit once, and return the detail the imported build_budget_version_detail builds from the same BudgetVersion object, empty plans and zero unresolved allocations.

open_points.subject: ensure_manual_budget
open_points.text: ensure_manual_budget: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a manual version already exists, MUST return the detail the imported build_budget_version_detail builds from that exact repository object, all and only its persisted plans ordered by sort_order then section_id and the unresolved allocation count, close the read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback, and append no audit.

open_points.subject: get_budget_version
open_points.text: get_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, read the exact version and its plans only through one budgets repository of the transaction, use only the list_project_expenses of the transaction called with the project_id of the context, with flattened aggregate allocations for the temporary allocation read, close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback, and use no legacy budget method.

open_points.question: The note must describe the repository boundary and one rollback without method-call prose or PortalTransaction.rollback dotted navigation.

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: upsert_manual_section_plan: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST reuse the repository's existing manual BudgetVersion object when present or otherwise build it with the imported build_manual_budget_version; for a supplied section_id it MUST obtain the exact project-scoped PortalSection or raise BudgetValidationError, while a missing section_id MUST build one = models.PortalSection with the imported build_manual_portal_section and insert it; both builders receive the context and the single utc_now instant of the operation as now.

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: upsert_manual_section_plan: [PROVENANCE] MUST pass as plan_id the plan_id of the plan the manual version already has for the stable section_id, and otherwise a fresh uuid4; it MUST upsert the = models.SectionPlan the imported build_manual_section_plan builds from the context, the manual version, the PortalSection, the supplied display_name and sort_order, the validated R9 amounts as material_planned and work_planned, that plan_id and the single utc_now instant as now, without altering any imported-version plan.

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: upsert_manual_section_plan: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST append an audit with the budget.manual_version_create member of = models.AuditAction only when this transaction creates the manual version and append exactly one success audit with its budget.section_plan_edit member for the upserted plan; it MUST build both intents with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the first with the BUDGET_VERSION member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the version_id, the second with its SECTION_PLAN member and the plan_id, and after commit it MUST return the detail the imported build_budget_version_detail builds from the same manual BudgetVersion object, all persisted plans ordered by sort_order then section_id, and the unresolved allocation count.

open_points.subject: validate_project_section
open_points.text: validate_project_section: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, read only by calling get_project_section of the project_sections repository PortalTransaction.project_sections returns with project_id and section_id, then close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it evaluates identity or raises BudgetValidationError, and use no PortalStore lookup or legacy PortalTransaction project-section method.
